channel.title: Skyline Vanguard — The Commute Briefing
channel.description: A daily ~20-minute editorial briefing for real-estate and insurance professionals, hosted by Tawny & Paul — mortgage rates, insurance regulation, real-estate transactions, construction, and business opportunity, pulled from Skyline Roofing's Vanguard newspaper.
channel.itunes:author: Skyline Roofing

item.title: Vanguard Commute Briefing — Sep 26, 2026
item.description:
Welcome to the Skyline Vanguard Daily Briefing — the twenty-minute commute podcast for real estate and insurance professionals. I'm Tawny. And I'm Paul. Good morning. Here's what matters today. Category Two hurricane bearing down on Hawaii as forecasters warn of potential historic rainfall and catastrophic flash flooding. Meanwhile, homeowners insurance in Florida is actually getting cheaper — approval notices came through just this week for four carriers.
Full edition: https://flipbooks.skylineroofllc.com/social-test/vanguard-video-2026-09-26/

item.description:

item.title: Vanguard Commute Briefing — Sep 24, 2026
item.description:
Welcome to the Skyline Vanguard Daily Briefing — the twenty-minute commute podcast for real estate and insurance professionals. I'm Tawny. And I'm Paul. Good morning. Here's what matters today. We've got five stories on the desk. Homebuilder earnings are under pressure — KB Home down twenty percent year over year, Lennar cutting delivery guidance. But Berkshire Hathaway just bought more Lennar stock, pushing its stake past ten percent. The market's reading that as a contrarian bet.
